data.narrative:
Aclarity is a Series A climate and energy company founded by Julie Bliss Mullen that has raised $14M to date. The valuation landscape for frontier-tech energy includes one public comparable (Lanzatech, ticker LNZA) and eight private peers spanning battery materials, hydrogen, and critical minerals (Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen among them). However, the private peer set lacks sufficient density at identical or adjacent stages to support a reliable peer-median approach; only one narrow comparable existed after filtering for stage and valuation tier.

Given this constraint, stage-progression methodology provides the primary valuation signal. Using total capital raised of $14M as a proxy for post-money valuation and applying a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A to follow-on progression yields an implied valuation of $28M. This represents a standard step-up absent company-specific acceleration or deterioration.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $24M to $32M, with a median point of $28M. Key uncertainties remain: the absence of tight peer comparables in Climate & Energy at this stage limits cross-check confidence, and the early-stage nature of the business means substantial execution risk is unpriced into this range. Further diligence on unit economics and capital efficiency relative to the peer cohort would refine this estimate.
